For our SFT experiments, we selected benchmarks to cover a wide range of capabilities. Specifically, we use HellaSwag for knowledge understanding, Wino-Grande for language understanding, and RACE for reading reasoning capabilities. For grounding and abstractive summarization, we employ PIQA . To evaluate more specialized skills, we utilize HumanEval (Chen et al., 2021) for coding, T-Eval (Chen et al., 2024) for tool use, and Xstory_cloze for multi-turn dialogues and multilingual tasks.
